marker.description: A blue-headed pin and a green-headed pin are inserted into the superior surface of the cerebral hemisphere.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the pins.
main_explanation: The pins are located on the medial aspect of the frontal lobe, superior to the cingulate gyrus and the longitudinal fissure, identifying the superior frontal gyrus.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located immediately inferior to the structure indicated by the pins?
supporting_question.explanation: The cingulate gyrus is located on the medial surface of the hemisphere, immediately inferior to the superior frontal gyrus and superior to the corpus callosum.
